Subject (in full) Reorganization of the Intelligence Staff of the Japanese
Consular Police in Shanghai.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross.

Regarding the report submitted on April 28, 1933, on the
above subject, I have to state that the Formosan Section of the
Second Section (Intelligence Office) of the Consular Police
Department have been increased by one Inspector and two Constables
who arrived here from Formosa on May 1, 1933.

D. I.

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. D 4/2）
Special Branch, A / Station 37
Date April 26, 1933.
Subject (in full) Reorganisation of the Intelligence Staff of the Japanese Consular Police in Shanghai.
Made by anl Forwarded by D.I. Ross.
Prior to the Hongkew Park Bomb Outrage in April 1932, the staff of the Intelligence Office attached to the local Japanese Consulate consisted of only 8 persons including the chief - Mr. Akagi. In consequence of this outrage and in order to deal effectively with Japanese nationals actively inclined toward the rising tide of subversive activities in the Far East, the local Japanese Consular Police was reorganised in September 1932, the Intelligence Office renamed the 2nd. Section of the Consular Police Department, and the strength of the staff authorised to be increased to 40 persons. Of this number 27 have already commenced their duties and are divided into the following sub-sections :
Chief of the Section............Consul.
Assistants 1 Chancellor, 1 clerk.
General Office 1 Inspector, 1 sergeant, 5 constables.
Chinese Section 1 Inspector, 3 sergeants.
Russian Section 1 Inspector, 1 sergeant.
Japanese Section 1 Inspector, 1 sergeant.
Korean Section 1 Vice-Consul, 1 Sub-Inspector, 1 sergeant and 3 constables.
Formosan Section. 1 Vice-Consul and 1 sergeant.
Inspection & Censorship Section 1 Inspector and 2 constables.
The remainder of the staff which is due to arrive shortly to commence duty in this office includes :
1 Vice-Consul, 1 Chief Inspector, 1 Chancellor, 2 Inspectors, 5 sergeants and constables, and 3 clerks.
（批：C.P. Information. JMc O. i/c Sp.）
Officer i/c Special Branch.
D. I.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. B. 登记处 档案编号 D 4/2）
特别科，A / 37 号分站
日期 1933 年 4 月 26 日。
主题（全称）关于上海日本领事馆警察情报人员的重组。
由 D.I. Ross 撰写并呈报。
在 1932 年 4 月虹口公园炸弹袭击事件之前，附属于当地日本领事馆的情报室人员仅有 8 人，包括主管——赤木（Akagi）先生。鉴于此次袭击事件，并为有效应对倾向于远东日益高涨的颠覆活动的日本国民，当地日本领事馆警察于 1932 年 9 月进行了重组，情报室更名为领事馆警察部第二科，并批准将人员编制增加至 40 人。其中 27 人已开始履职，并划分为以下各组：
科长............领事。
助理 1 名书记官，1 名文员。
总务组 1 名巡官，1 名警长，5 名警员。
中国组 1 名巡官，3 名警长。
俄国组 1 名巡官，1 名警长。
日本组 1 名巡官，1 名警长。
朝鲜组 1 名副领事，1 名副巡官，1 名警长和 3 名警员。
台湾组。1 名副领事和 1 名警长。
检查与审查组 1 名巡官和 2 名警员。
其余即将抵达并开始在本办公室履职的人员包括：
1 名副领事，1 名总巡官，1 名书记官，2 名巡官，5 名警长和警员，以及 3 名文员。
（批注：C.P. 信息。JMc O. i/c Sp.）
特别科科长。
D. I.
